propositions: Non-create plans (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) must execute atomic postconditions once in dependency order through a provider-neutral coordinator.
Late failures in compound operations must preserve proven earlier postconditions and re-observe only remaining drift rather than replaying the entire mutation.
Already-gone deletes and ticket-local 404s must be treated as idempotent success, while permanent 4xx and broad failures isolate only their declared scope.
Coordinator must produce exact per-ticket outcome buckets (applied, recovered, deferred, failed, skipped) via a normalized Disposition vocabulary with 11 internal states mapping to 5 outcome buckets.
Re-observation of remaining drift occurs in the next reconcile_once pass through a fresh Observation and plan_pass, not mid-pass within the coordinator.
